title: fix(core): an artifact entry wrapped correctly ends its refusal on the content refusal, not on wrapper or glob advice
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DH9e4qEZ6HPSFPqXCYcdFui)_

Fixes #32479

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:发布产物里某个 `packages[]` 条目被拒时,拒绝文本末尾的建议现在只在真有对应问题时才出现。包装层错了给「包装成 `{ manifest: … }`」的建议,包体里放了 glob 字符串给「装配态包体放定义而非 glob」的建议,包装正确、只是内容被拒(页面、id、未声明键等)就以内容拒因本身收尾。
- **为什么改**:以前每次拒绝都附上这两段通用建议,作者被引去看包装层和 glob,而真正要改的是页面或内容本身。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低。只改错误文本,错误码 `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY`、状态 422、开头句和引用的 issue 都不变,拒绝与否也不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`(`isWrapperShapeIssue` 与 `isGlobPatternIssue` 两个判定,决定哪段建议出现);`packages/core/src/artifact-packages.test.ts`(新 describe,三个分支各自钉住)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/artifact-packages.test.ts`,预期 18/18 通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`resolveArtifactPackageEntries` (`packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`, ADR-0130 D4) refuses a malformed `packages[]` entry as `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY` / `422`, quoting up to five parse issues. Until now it appended the same two pieces of advice to every such refusal, whatever the issue was. Now each piece is said only to the entry it answers:

- **Wrapper advice** ("Each entry is a WRAPPER object … wrap an inlined body as `{ manifest: { … } }` …"): given when an issue sits at the entry root (the entry is not an object, or carries keys beside `manifest` / `source`, which is how an inlined body shows up), or is an `invalid_type` at `manifest` (missing, or not an object).
- **Assembled-body advice** ("The body under `manifest:` is the ASSEMBLED package body … not the authoring manifest's glob patterns …"): given when an issue sits on `manifest.objects` / `manifest.datasources` (the collection or one element of it) and the entry holds a string there. The test reads the entry's own value at the issue path rather than the issue's message.
- **Neither**: any other refusal ends on the quoted issues and, when some are withheld, on the `(+N more)` count. This covers a page the page parse refuses (the card's case), an invalid `manifest.id`, an undeclared key inside the body (reported AT `manifest`, but as `unrecognized_keys`, so not a wrapper issue), an invalid item definition and an invalid `source`.

The advice is chosen over every issue, withheld ones included, because it is advice about the entry. One more thing changes: a quoted issue whose sentence already ends on a period is no longer followed by a second one (the `manifest.id` refusal used to read `… not admitted.. Each entry …`).

Unchanged: the error code, the status, the leading sentence (`… \`packages[N]\` is not a package entry (ADR-0130 D4): …`), the quoted issues, the cap, and what is refused.

Design choice, recorded per the dispatch axes: the leading sentence still says "is not a package entry" for a content refusal. That stays true, because "package entry" means an entry `ArtifactPackageSchema` admits and that schema parses the whole body. Rewording it would also change text that `packages/runtime/src/security/artifact-granted-permissions.test.ts` (three assertions) and `packages/plugins/plugin-dev/src/dev-plugin-malformed-stack-posture.test.ts` assert on, which is outside this card's file surface. The card asked only about the tail.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/artifact-packages.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` that pins all three branches. Four wrapper cases carry the wrapper advice and not the glob advice. Three glob cases carry the glob advice and not the wrapper advice. Four content cases carry neither, and the message ends on the schema's own sentence for the last issue, read off `ArtifactPackageSchema.safeParse` of the same entry rather than copied into the test. One case with withheld issues ends on the `(+N more).` count. Every case asserts the `code` + `status` envelope.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-package-record-page-no-component.test.ts`: the whole-artifact case (the card's reach) now also asserts that neither piece of advice follows the page's sentence.
- No existing test pinned the old tail for a content refusal, so none was rewritten. `packages/objectql/src/artifact-load-path.test.ts`'s glob case asserts `DEFINITIONS`, which the glob branch still says, and it passes unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- The schema's own `unrecognized_keys` message for an entry root (`ArtifactPackageSchema`'s `history` text) already says "wrap it as `{ manifest: { … } }`", so an inlined body's refusal states the wrapper advice twice: once from the schema and once from the resolver. That was already the case before this change. It is noted, not changed here, because the schema's text is a spec surface.
- The objectql pin was not ablated separately. It reaches the resolver through `@objectstack/core`'s `dist/`, and the behaviour it measures is ablated once, at the core layer, where the test imports the source.

## Verification

All readings on head `4508345431`.

<details><summary>Premise on origin/main b392ff7bdf (before any edit)</summary>

A probe calling `resolveArtifactPackageEntries` over 13 entry shapes found that every refusal ended with both pieces of advice. That included the page-places-no-component refusal (`manifest.pages.0.regions`), `manifest.id: Invalid package id ''` (followed by `.. Each entry is a WRAPPER object …`), `source: Invalid option`, and an undeclared body key. Premise holds.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (core pin, source-resolved: no dist leg needed)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts --anchor "issues.some(isWrapperShapeIssue) ? WRAPPER_SHAPE_ADVICE : ''," --replacement "WRAPPER_SHAPE_ADVICE, ASSEMBLED_BODY_ADVICE, // ABLATION"` restored the old always-append tail. The tool reported the anchor going from 1 to 0 hits and the blob from f1c2cd7e8e8f to e4e83491cab0. Under that mutation, 12/12 new pins went red (every wrapper, glob and content case, plus the withheld-count case), and the 6 pre-existing cases stayed green. After the restore, `git diff HEAD` and `git status --porcelain` were empty and the marker count was 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

Every command ran through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and was read off its `VERDICT command-exit` line.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test` exit 0: Test Files 146 passed (146), Tests 3392 passed (3392).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/artifact-packages.test.ts` exit 0: Tests 18 passed (18).
- Rebuilt core with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core build`, and checked that `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs` carry `isGlobPatternIssue` (2 hits each). Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/registry-package-record-page-no-component.test.ts src/artifact-load-path.test.ts src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts` exit 0: Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 48 passed (48).
- These dependents assert on this refusal's text (`git grep -n "is not a package entry"`):
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/security/artifact-granted-permissions.test.ts src/standalone-stack-option-b-forward-conversion.test.ts src/app-plugin.option-b-packages.test.ts`: Tests 25 passed (25).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-dev exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/dev-plugin-malformed-stack-posture.test.ts`: Tests 4 passed (4).
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/artifact-forward-conversion-package-body.test.ts`: Tests 202 passed (202).
  - Their combined lock VERDICT: command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` (`NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`) exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` reported OK for both: core 4 pinned signatures held, objectql 64 held.
- `test:repo` was not run locally. CI runs it as `Test Core`.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `npx eslint` on the 3 changed source and test files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs`: exit 0. It reported "check-test-source-alias OK — 122 packages with tests scanned … judged 2 test file(s) changed since b392ff7bdf".
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: exit 0.
- The derived local subset (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, change set of 4 paths against merge base b392ff7bd) has 64 families. 63 exited 0.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with "PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/". That reads as **NOT MEASURED** locally, because only the affected closures were built. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it on a full build.
- `--ran` reconciliation, with the exit codes recorded: "64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 63 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- No exported symbol was renamed or removed, so `check-platform-checklist --changed-from` is not owed.
- Dogfood not run: the title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
